sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 38

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 38:1
items.html: It was already explained above in answer 37, that the five [discernments] HGT NH of ZA are the five discernments KHB ZON. Thus the Tifferet is Bina, the Netzah is ZA, and the Hod is the Nukva. (ibid.).
